notablePrerequisites: You control at least four lands.
description:
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying {6}{R}.
Holding priority, activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Dualcaster Mage.
Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, copying Brass's Bounty.
Resolve the copy of Brass's Bounty, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat from step 2.
